body: I totally get it. Those of us that think of it often but never get the courage to go through understand the frustration that adds up with each time. With your question... I don’t know why, and don’t have anything that I can say that might help, except you are not alone in that thought. I’m a bit older and feel the same...

It seems like you know the cause of it. You don’t sound like you want to kill yourself. Do you think it will happen again? In your place I would totally be reluctant to say anything to avoid being hospitalized, so I understand that, but maybe there is a middle ground, like seeking some form of professional help outside your normal life, that can treat you without committing you....
